description: Slew limiter — when the input changes quickly, the output follows more slowly

params.text: The rise time, calibrated as the time the output would need to catch up with a 10V rise, 0 to 10 seconds
Curves the rising movement, between logarithmic, linear and exponential
The fall time, calibrated as the time the output would need to catch up with a 10V fall, 0 to 10 seconds
Curves the falling movement, between logarithmic, linear and exponential

inputs.text: A 0-10V CV over the rise time, attenuated by the RISE knob
A 0-10V CV over the fall time, attenuated by the FALL knob
The signal the output chases; the channels patched here set the polyphony

outputs.text: The input with its changes slowed to the rise and fall settings
